annotations.title: Look up frost risk this week for a place

description: Forecast lows for the next 7 days at any place and the nights at risk of frost. Each frost night is dated by the morning its low falls on, so protect plants the evening before that date. Works without a Siltwell account. For the signed-in user's own garden, get_forecast returns this forecast with the garden's microclimate adjustment applied.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Give it with longitude instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Give it with latitude instead of place.

place.description: Town plus region or country, for example "Portland, Oregon". Omit it to use the signed-in user's garden.
